title: Your Company Stock Is a $47K Time Bomb in Your 401k
hook: You're already betting your salary on your employer every day — your 401k might be doubling down on that bet, and most workers have no idea.
angle: Workers unknowingly concentrate retirement risk in employer stock — a double exposure that destroyed Enron employees and lurks in millions of 401ks today
audience: Anyone with a 401k that includes employer stock or equity compensation
key_numbers: 14% average employer stock allocation vs 5% safe limit
Enron employees lost $2 billion in 401k savings in 2001
$47,000 average risk exposure for over-concentrated workers
